008package release.support;
009
010import java.io.*;
011import java.nio.file.*;
012
013public final class FileOps {
014
015    private FileOps() {
016
017    }
018
019    public static void copyMatchingFiles(Path fromDir, String glob, Path destDir) throws IOException {
020        try (DirectoryStream<Path> stream = Files.newDirectoryStream(fromDir, glob)) {
021            for (Path file : stream) {
022                Files.copy(file, destDir.resolve(file.getFileName()), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
023                System.out.println("✅ Copied " + file.getFileName() + " → " + destDir.getFileName());
024            }
025        }
026    }
027
028    public static void copyDirectory(Path source, Path target) throws IOException {
029        try (java.util.stream.Stream<Path> paths = Files.walk(source)) {
030            paths.forEach(path -> {
031                try {
032                    Path dest = target.resolve(source.relativize(path).toString());
033                    if (Files.isDirectory(path)) {
034                        Files.createDirectories(dest);
035                    } else {
036                        Files.copy(path, dest, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
037                    }
038                } catch (IOException e) {
039                    throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
040                }
041            });
042        }
043    }
044
045    /**
046     * Deletes the test build of a version once that version has been built as a release.
047     * <p>
048     * A "Rebuild only" run names its folder after the current version, including
049     * {@code -SNAPSHOT} (e.g. {@code Glyco-PAINT-0.0.138-SNAPSHOT}). Once the release folder
050     * {@code Glyco-PAINT-0.0.138} exists, that test build is superseded and only confusing.
051     * Does nothing if {@code buildRoot} is itself a SNAPSHOT build, or if there is no test build.
052     *
053     * @param buildRoot the folder just built, e.g. {@code .../Glyco-PAINT-Builds/Glyco-PAINT-0.0.138}
054     * @return {@code true} if a superseded SNAPSHOT folder was deleted
055     * @throws IOException if the folder exists but cannot be deleted
056     */
057    public static boolean removeSupersededSnapshotBuild(Path buildRoot) throws IOException {
058        String name = buildRoot.getFileName().toString();
059        if (name.endsWith("-SNAPSHOT")) {
060            return false;
061        }
062        Path snapshotBuild = buildRoot.resolveSibling(name + "-SNAPSHOT");
063        if (!Files.isDirectory(snapshotBuild)) {
064            return false;
065        }
066        deleteDirectory(snapshotBuild);
067        System.out.println("🧹 Removed superseded test build " + snapshotBuild.getFileName());
068        return true;
069    }
070
071    private static void deleteDirectory(Path dir) throws IOException {
072        Files.walkFileTree(dir, new SimpleFileVisitor<Path>() {
073            @Override
074            public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes attrs)
075                    throws IOException {
076                Files.delete(file);
077                return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
078            }
079
080            @Override
081            public FileVisitResult postVisitDirectory(Path d, IOException exc) throws IOException {
082                if (exc != null) {
083                    throw exc;
084                }
085                Files.delete(d);
086                return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
087            }
088        });
089    }
090
091    public static void zipPayload(Path appDir, Path pluginDir, Path outputZip) throws Exception {
092        // zip -qry outputZip .
093        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder("zip", "-qry", outputZip.toString(), ".");
094        pb.directory(appDir.toFile());
095        pb.inheritIO();
096        if (pb.start().waitFor() != 0) {
097            throw new RuntimeException("❌ Failed to zip payload at " + appDir);
098        }
099
100        if (Files.exists(pluginDir)) {
101            try (java.util.stream.Stream<Path> s = Files.list(pluginDir)) {
102                if (s.findAny().isPresent()) {
103
104                    String cmdStr = String.format(
105                            "cd \"%s\" && mkdir -p ../_plugin_tmp && cp -R . ../_plugin_tmp/plugin && " +
106                                    "cd ../_plugin_tmp && zip -qry \"%s\" plugin && cd .. && rm -rf _plugin_tmp",
107                            pluginDir.toAbsolutePath(), outputZip.toAbsolutePath()
108                    );
109
110                    ProcessBuilder addPb = new ProcessBuilder("bash", "-c", cmdStr);
111                    addPb.inheritIO();
112
113                    if (addPb.start().waitFor() != 0) {
114                        throw new RuntimeException("❌ Failed to append plugin to " + outputZip);
115                    }
116                }
117            }
118        }
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * Resolves exactly one expected build artifact, by name.
123     * <p>
124     * This deliberately replaces an earlier "newest file matching a loose pattern" lookup. A
125     * Maven target directory does not hold one candidate: {@code maven-shade-plugin} leaves the
126     * pre-shade jar behind as {@code original-<name>.jar} alongside the real, shaded one. A
127     * pattern such as {@code .*jar$} matches both, and picking the most recently modified one is
128     * a race — shade writes them within milliseconds of each other. Losing that race means
129     * shipping a thin, non-runnable jar under the official release name.
130     * <p>
131     * Artifact names are deterministic, so ask for the one we mean and fail loudly if it is not
132     * there.
133     *
134     * @param dir      the directory to look in (typically a module's {@code target})
135     * @param fileName the exact name expected, e.g. {@code paint-installer-macos-1.2.3.jar}, or a
136     *                 macOS app bundle (a folder) such as {@code Glyco-PAINT.app}
137     * @return the path to that artifact
138     * @throws IOException if it does not exist, listing what the directory does contain
139     */
140    public static Path requireArtifact(Path dir, String fileName) throws IOException {
141        Path artifact = dir.resolve(fileName);
142        boolean appBundle = fileName.endsWith(".app");
143        if (appBundle ? Files.isDirectory(artifact) : Files.isRegularFile(artifact)) {
144            return artifact;
145        }
146
147        StringBuilder present = new StringBuilder();
148        if (Files.isDirectory(dir)) {
149            try (java.util.stream.Stream<Path> stream = Files.list(dir)) {
150                stream.map(p -> p.getFileName().toString())
151                      .sorted()
152                      .forEach(name -> present.append("\n    ").append(name));
153            }
154        } else {
155            present.append("\n    (directory does not exist)");
156        }
157
158        throw new IOException("Expected build artifact not found: " + artifact
159                + "\n  Directory contains:" + present);
160    }
161}
